title: Focus Active Window Engagement Input
description: When a window is active and has engagement, auto-focus the engagement input. Fix CAD play typing hitting all panes (global key capture + replIsQueryTypingTarget). Wire window activation to focus model definition.
summary: Active windows now auto-focus the engagement command input (`Engagement` receives `active` from `Window`). CAD play only registers REPL global key capture on the focused model-definition pane (`captureGlobalKeys`), `replIsQueryTypingTarget` treats text inputs/engagement fields as typing targets, and `app.onActiveWindowChange` syncs window tabs to `focusModelDefinition`. All @ui/react (55) and @cad/js/renderer (47) tests pass.
